the_separation: Filled completes rest a median of 1.0 tick(s) from the best opposite ask; unfilled ones rest a median of 3.0 ticks away, p75 8 and as far as 48. Distance from touch, not rest time, is what separates them: median rest 7.91s filled against 30.67s unfilled is the deadline, not a cause.
the_finding: In 164 of 404 (40.6%) unfilled completes L5's OWN touch moved above where we were sitting, and in 96 of those the opposite ask reached that new touch -- 23.8% of all unfilled completes had an L5-CONSISTENT reprice available that the book would have met. We never made it: we post once and sit to the deadline. Placement is not the defect -- we price AT L5's touch in 70.3% of them.
upper_bound_not_an_estimate: rest_book is an AGGREGATE. min_opp_ask and max_touch are extrema over the same window and we cannot prove they coincided, so the count where both held is an UPPER BOUND on what repricing would have captured. Reaching a price is also not filling it -- we rest as maker and queue position decides -- and repricing to the touch can cross, which post-only refuses.
classification: BEHAVIORAL-FIDELITY FIX, not a new strategy: L5's touch moved and our clone did not follow it. Following L5's own price is cloning him; paying up to get filled would not be.
